site.title: Manga Café Porto
site.descriptor: Manga café & creative space in Cedofeita
site.og_description: Manga café & creative space in Cedofeita, Porto. Manga, coffee, tea, and community.

blurb.text: A cozy corner in Cedofeita where you can read manga, work, study, or simply unwind with a coffee or tea. A space for Porto's creative community.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.includes: Includes: unlimited manga reading, tea & coffee
pricing.note: All passes include unlimited manga, tea & coffee, and are paid at the café.
pricing.nomad_desc: Focused work & study time in a creative environment
pricing.nomad_perk: Free entry between 12 pm and 4 pm on weekdays
pricing.vip_desc: The ultimate pass for the true community member
pricing.vip_perk: Free entry during all hours and events
pricing.paid_at_cafe: All passes are paid at the café.

library.title: Manga

events.title: Events
events.blurb: We host regular events — from Horo-yoi nights with sake and snacks to reading meetups and creative workshops. Follow us to find out what's coming up.
